name: doomscroll
description: A TikTok-style video feed in a pane beside Claude Code. It plays while Claude works, scrolls with your mouse wheel, and pauses when Claude is done.

mix.title: For You mix
mix.description: Fill the feed from a built-in mix of about 70 creators (comedy, memes, slop, animals, sports and more), sampled fresh each session. Off: only your creators.

creators.title: Your creators
creators.description: Comma-separated TikTok handles that are always in your feed, on top of the For You mix. /doomscroll add @someone also works.

sound.title: Sound on
sound.description: Start with sound on. m in the pane, or /doomscroll mute, toggles it and is remembered.

autoOpen.title: Open while Claude works
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself whenever Claude starts a turn. Off: only /doomscroll opens it.
